title: Raw projective-line trace adjustment
statement: For a presentation e:X ≅ P1_Y of the proper map q, the shifted Tate coefficient on X admits an automorphism comparing the two explicit transported trace composites: one uses shifted-line pullback inverse and geometric push-pull; the other uses the adjunction-unit coefficient identification in the presented trace. This is an equality of explicit composites and asserts no adjunction. Interfaces: [def-asd-presented-projective-line-trace-model] and [def-sf-p1-integral-transport-data].

source.place: Both diagonal triangle calculations and the actual inverse-projection counit.

proof.text: Apply module-valued trace adjustment with B the shifted Tate line on X, L the shifted Tate line on P1_Y, both coefficient comparisons the specified shifted-line pullback, z the geometric push-pull comparison, trace the arbitrary-base splitting trace and final map the constant-complex unit comparison. Substitution gives the displayed equation without using the supported diagonal class.

theorem exists_presentedFiniteP1RawAdjustment
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A] (N : ℕ) (hA : (N : A) = 0)
    (t : OrdinaryFiniteTwistTransport A N hA)
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper q]
    (e : X ≅ ProjectiveLine Y) (w : e.hom ≫ (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y) = q)
    (hY : IsUnit (N : Γ(Y, ⊤))) (d : ArbitraryBaseFiniteP1Splitting A N hA t Y hY) :
    let B := (ordinaryFiniteLine A N hA X)⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧
    let L := (ordinaryFiniteLine A N hA (ProjectiveLine Y))⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧
    let g := (ProjectiveLine Y ↘ Y)
    let bL := ordinaryFiniteShiftedLinePullback A N hA t e.hom
      (finiteP1_unitOnPullback N g hY)
    let v := bL
    let z := SfP1Transport.pushPull A e
    let τ := d.trace
    let j := (SfP1Transport.constantUnit A Y).hom
    ∃ a : B ≅ B,
      (rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) q).map a.hom ≫
        ((rightDerivedLowerShriekIsoRightDerivedLowerStar
            (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) q).hom.app B ≫
          (ordinaryFinitePushforward A q).map v.inv ≫
          (rightDerivedLowerStarCompOfEq (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) e.hom g q w).inv.app
            ((ordinaryFinitePullback A e.hom).obj L) ≫
          (ordinaryFinitePushforward A g).map (z.hom.app L) ≫ τ ≫ j) =
      (rightDerivedLowerShriekIsoRightDerivedLowerStar
          (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) q).hom.app B ≫
        ((rightDerivedLowerStarCongr (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) w).inv.app B ≫
          (rightDerivedLowerStarComp (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) e.hom g).inv.app B ≫
          (ordinaryFinitePushforward A g).map
            (asIso ((derivedUpperStarLowerStarAdjunction
                (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) e.hom).unit.app L) ≪≫
              (ordinaryFinitePushforward A e.hom).mapIso bL).inv ≫ τ) ≫ j
